subject: BlueForge — Technical deep-dive & live demo coordination
messages:
From: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@blueforge.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@blueforge.io
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Technical deep-dive & live demo — BlueForge / Redwood evaluation

Hi Irene / Ben,

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier — BlueForge is excited about Redwood's inference economics and the routing features you mentioned. Our engineering leadership would like a more technical session (engineering-to-engineering) to validate fit before procurement.

High-level ask: a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive that includes a short live demo showing: model routing/fallback, KV cache behavior on longer contexts, and an example of deploying in our VPC with KMS integration.

Attendees from our side: Alex Ruiz (platform lead), Samira Khan (security/compliance), Marcus Lee (SRE).

Proposed windows next week (all times PT):
 - Tue Oct 13: 08:00–11:30 or 13:00–16:00
 - Wed Oct 14: 08:00–12:00

Can you share an agenda and who from Redwood would run each section? Also let us know if you need network constraints or a brief diagram ahead of time.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Ruiz | Platform Lead, BlueForge Analytics
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@blueforge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Technical deep-dive & live demo — BlueForge / Redwood evaluation

Hi Alex — great to hear and glad the initial discovery was useful. Happy to run a focused engineering session. Proposed plan (attached agenda + short architecture PDF):

 - 10 mins: Introductions & success criteria (Irene)
 - 20 mins: Architecture walk-through — hosted vs. private deployment (Ben)
 - 20 mins: Live demo — routing, KV caching, and latency traces (Marissa)
 - 20 mins: Security & compliance touchpoints (Karthik)
 - 10–20 mins: Q&A + next steps / rollout plan

We can compress to 60 minutes if you prefer — we usually recommend 75 for a deeper KV-caching demo. I attached: redwood-arch-overview.pdf and a draft mvp-demo-agenda.md.

Proposed slots (PT):
 - Tue Oct 13, 09:30–11:00
 - Tue Oct 13, 14:00–15:30
 - Wed Oct 14, 09:00–10:30

If you send any network constraints or the team’s public IP blocks, Karthik will triage what we need for a VPC connectivity demo.

Cheers,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@blueforge.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@blueforge.io>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Technical deep-dive & live demo — BlueForge / Redwood evaluation

Thanks Irene — quick note from security: we’re aiming to include a brief SOC 2 / data residency checkpoint in the session and will need an architecture diagram that highlights where data at rest lives and KMS/HSM integration points.

Also, our leadership prefers a 60-minute, tightly focused session (no more than 1 hour). Can you run a condensed flow that hits the routing/fallback demo and a short Private deployment sketch?

Preferred slot (ET): Tue Oct 13, 11:00–12:00 ET (that would be 08:00–09:00 PT). If that doesn’t work, Wed Oct 14 morning ET is also possible.

I’ll attach a short network constraints doc — sending separately.

—Samira
Samira Khan
Security & Compliance, BlueForge Analytics
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@blueforge.io>, Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@blueforge.io>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Technical deep-dive & live demo — BlueForge / Redwood evaluation

Hi Samira / Alex — thanks for the clarity. We can run a focused 60-minute session that prioritizes: routing/fallback demo + quick sketch of Private (VPC + KMS) and a 10-minute compliance Q&A.

Confirming Tue Oct 13 / 11:00–12:00 ET (08:00–09:00 PT). Attending from Redwood: Ben Carter (host), Karthik Iyer (network & infra constraints), Marissa Cole (live demo + infra examples). I’ll bring the condensed agenda (mvp-demo-agenda.md) and a pared-down architecture slide.

I attached the agenda draft — happy to tighten if you want specific demos called out.

Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben — appreciate the quick turn. One update on our end: an exec all-hands just moved into Alex and Samira’s morning window on Tue the 13th so can we shift to Wed Oct 14?

Would Wed Oct 14 09:00 PT (12:00 ET) work for Redwood? We still prefer a 60-minute slot.

Apologies for the churn — happy to confirm once I hear from Marcus about attendee timing.

Alex / Samira — Wed Oct 14 09:00 PT (12:00 ET / 19:00 CEST) works for us. We’ll keep it to 60 minutes and prioritize routing + private/VPC sketch + a short compliance checklist. Calendar invite & Zoom link coming from my calendar in a few minutes.

Pre-demo checklist (quick):
 - Confirm attendee list and roles (platform / security / SRE)
 - Share any IP allowlist or network constraints (send to karthik.iyer@redwood.ai)
 - Preferred test model or prompt examples if you’d like a tailored demo
